propositions: All structured-output consumers must route through the single PydanticAIRunner facade and one-operation Pydantic Agent path, eliminating bespoke retry loops and compatibility delegation
The structured_retry_limit parameter is retained as the output-retry-allowance cap, with structured_retry_limit=0 yielding exactly one Agent output attempt (single-shot) and zero repair retries
The output-retry allowance N seeds both the Agent retries budget and the constructed UsageLimits request budget, ensuring the request budget cannot trigger before the output-retry counter
A well-formed first response triggers exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; the bug-895c downgrade triggers exactly two (native then prompted); no third outer run is permitted
All in-tree mode=structured consumers identified by mode-resolving AST census (not text grep) already route through the facade; no call-site rewrite is needed
Existing provider fallback order, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, artifact policy, and serialized shapes remain unchanged and pass historical regression suites
